comment: Recognition layer 2: community/district entry signs along the Airport→Ochi route. Coordinates are real OSM lat/lon, projected into world space by road.project(). radius = trigger distance in compressed-world meters (world scale = 30% of real). Entries marked needs_owner_review need confirmation from the owner's lived knowledge — flag before shipping.
